description: Update profile fields: display name, bio, home currency, nationality, and the visited-countries list. Omitted fields keep their value. visitedCountries replaces the whole list, so read get_profile first when adding to it. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

bio.description: Short profile blurb; null clears it.

homeCurrency.description: ISO currency code new trips and prices default to.

nationality.description: ISO alpha-2 country code of the passport; null clears it.

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

visitedCountries.description: ISO alpha-2 codes of every country visited; replaces the whole list.

name: update_profile
title: Update the traveler's profile
